thesis: A stable-margin, 14%-ROIC IT services franchise with an 11.39% FCF yield and 5% annual share shrinkage trades below its own 5-year minimum on every multiple and below peers on P/E, where the price implies a 9.4% revenue decline its fundamentals do not show.
reason: Cash yield plus buybacks cushion the downside even if no re-rating comes, and margins remain steady. Sector-wide AI-disruption pricing, slipping ROIC/ROE, rising leverage and no revenue-growth data cap conviction at 4, not 5: standard volatility-scaled core size. Mechanical fair value likely overstates value, so scenario targets sit well below it.

triggers.text: TTM ROIC falls below 12%, well under the five-year range of 14.8%-16.5%, signalling the switching-cost moat is eroding.
TTM operating margin falls below 15%, breaking the 16.1%-16.5% band held for five years, showing AI-driven pricing pressure or broken cost discipline.
TTM FCF margin falls below 11%, under the five-year low of 13.3%, showing cash generation can no longer fund buybacks and tuck-ins.
Annual revenue (income statement) declines year on year for a full fiscal year, evidencing real displacement of labour-based services by AI.
